methodology_source: Claude-Mythos (Anthropic, April 2026) — deep semantic source analysis + Z3-style boundary-condition verification, per the knowledge-base papers 'Benchmarking Mythos-Linked Bug Rediscovery' (2605.17416) and 'Mythos and the Unverified Cage' (2604.20496). The 27-year-old OpenBSD TCP SACK CWE-190 integer overflow was found this way — NOT by fuzzing.

application_to_nmap.target: DNS::Factory::parseDomainName + DNS::Packet::parseFromBuffer (libnetutil/massdns.cc) — the response-driven DNS parser analogous to OpenBSD's SACK processing
application_to_nmap.invariant_hunted: accumulated offset <= maxlen (the boundary condition Z3 would check: WD1)

paths_traced.arithmetic: curr_offset += label_length after DNS_CHECK_UPPER_BOUND(curr_offset + label_length, maxlen)
paths_traced.verdict: SAFE — label_length <= 63 (DNS_LABEL_MAX_LENGTH), checked before read; curr_offset+label_length bounded vs maxlen before append

paths_traced.arithmetic: real_offset = wire_u16 - 0xC000; backwards-only enforced (real_offset < curr_offset); max_offset = curr_offset + tmp
paths_traced.verdict: SAFE — parseUnsignedShort requires maxlen > curr_offset+1, so curr_offset+2 <= maxlen; backwards-only pointers prevent loops

paths_traced.arithmetic: return max_offset - offset; max_offset tracks highest byte touched
paths_traced.verdict: SAFE — max_offset <= maxlen in all branches; so returned length <= maxlen - offset

paths_traced.z3_finding: POTENTIAL WRAP: if offset > maxlen, maxlen - offset wraps to huge, check passes
paths_traced.exploitability_verdict: NOT REACHABLE — callers only pass offset = accumulated ret which is <= maxlen by the invariant above. The wrap requires a sub-parse to return more than remaining bytes, which every traced path prevents. (This is exactly the Mythos pattern: the arithmetic hazard exists in isolation but the caller invariant protects it — same structure as the guarded SACK form WD3 UNSAT)

paths_traced.z3_finding: maxlen - 1 wraps to SIZE_MAX if maxlen == 0 — check becomes curr_offset > SIZE_MAX (always false)
paths_traced.exploitability_verdict: NOT REACHABLE — Packet::parseFromBuffer requires maxlen >= DNS::DATA (12); no caller passes maxlen=0

git_history_pattern_mining.method: mined every OOB/overflow fix in nmap history to generate sibling patterns
findings: a2db276f3 (Jul 2026): ptrToIp OOB read for short names — fix present in our tree (both IPv4 and IPv6 variants)
068dd4b0d (Feb 2025): IPv6 HopByHop PAD1 bytes_left++ instead of -- — found by AFL++; fix present; DestOptsHeader inherits HopByHopHeader so both covered
ef71e5e37 (Oct 2023): trie_split OOB -> runaway allocations (nbase_addrset) — fix present (i >= 4 guard)
3adaa69cb (2021): PTR record parsing OOB — fix present
git_history_pattern_mining.sibling_audit_result: No unfixed siblings found: all similar pointer-arithmetic patterns in the current tree are guarded

conclusion: Mythos-mode applied: semantic invariant tracing + boundary-condition analysis on the deepest response-driven parser. Two arithmetic hazards found in isolation (unsigned wrap in Query entry check; maxlen-1 wrap at final access), both unreachable due to caller invariants — the same guarded-form structure Mythos verified with Z3 (WD3 UNSAT). The massdns parser joins the fuzzing evidence (1.07B+ clean executions) with hand-verified semantic safety. No 27-year bug equivalent found in this parser.
